h1: Custom Bags with a Lid for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Bags with a Lid | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom bags with a lid for bulk. Perfect for corporate gifts, events, and promotions. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Bags with a lid combine the convenience of open-top totes with the security of a sealed closure. Whether you need insulated coolers for employee appreciation or gift sets with spill-proof compartments, these bags keep contents contained and protected. Options like the Therm-O Cooler Tote or Igloo Playmate series offer durable construction and ample space for branding. Choose from full-color imprint or embroidery to showcase your logo while providing practical storage for lunches, gear, or promotional items.
heroAltText: Custom bags with a lid featuring a branded cooler tote with zippered closure and embroidered logo
